entries.title: Kinetic typography: a quote becomes a story
entries.title_zh: 动态文字：让一句话变成视觉叙事
entries.author: umesh_ai
entries.lesson: The brief assigns successive phrases their own timing, visual scale and transition. Finish with a readable hold rather than continuous motion.
entries.lesson_zh: 为各段文字分配时间、字号变化与转场，最后留出静止阅读时间。

entries.title: Headphone commercial: macro to exploded view
entries.title_zh: 耳机广告：从材质微距到结构拆解
entries.author: LudovicCreator
entries.lesson: Four timed sections connect material detail, a rotating product, separated components and reassembly. The geometry constraints make this useful for studying product continuity.
entries.lesson_zh: 四段时间线连接材质细节、产品旋转、零件分离和重新组装；重点学习几何形状的连续性约束。

entries.title: Character entrance: detail to full silhouette
entries.title_zh: 角色登场：从局部揭示到完整轮廓
entries.author: aimikoda
entries.lesson: A single identity reference anchors a progression from a small detail to body, expression and full silhouette. Reproduction requires a suitable character reference.
entries.lesson_zh: 用一个身份参考贯穿局部、身体、表情和全身轮廓的逐步揭示；复现时需要准备角色参考图。

entries.title: Blue-studio fashion: three references in one scene
entries.title_zh: 蓝色摄影棚时尚片：三参考同场
entries.author: egeberkina
entries.lesson: The prompt gives each reference a distinct actor and combines choreography with graphic overlays. Identity assets are required; the text alone is not a complete reproduction package.
entries.lesson_zh: 提示词为每张参考图指定不同主体，再结合编舞与图形叠加；仅有文字不足以完整复现，还需要身份素材。

entries.title: Bamboo-forest mystery: tension through close-ups
entries.title_zh: 竹林悬疑：用近景与正反打建立张力
entries.author: sipteaandcoffee
entries.lesson: Color, depth, lighting and shot/reverse-shot coverage carry the drama. The prompt constrains the period setting without supplying a timed dialogue script.
entries.lesson_zh: 以色彩、景深、布光和正反打组织戏剧张力；原文限制时代环境，但没有提供带时间点的对白脚本。

entries.title: Ordinary footage, impossible event: a useful mismatch
entries.title_zh: 日常影像与不可能事件：值得研究的偏差
entries.author: cocktailpeanut
entries.lesson: The brief delays its impossible event behind ordinary activity. This is useful for studying setup and surprise, alongside whether H3 follows the requested physical event.
entries.lesson_zh: 通过日常活动铺垫再引出不可能事件，适合研究伏笔、突变，以及模型是否按指定物理事件执行。

entries.title: Beat-driven western title sequence
entries.title_zh: 西部片头：让剪辑服从节拍
entries.author: doctorwasif
entries.lesson: Study how held poses alternate with short action bursts, with titles reserved for strong musical accents.
entries.lesson_zh: 学习静止姿态与短动作交替，并让标题落在音乐重拍上。

entries.title: Skincare campaign: night-to-morning continuity
entries.title_zh: 护肤广告：夜晚到清晨的连续性
entries.author: AIwithJessica
entries.lesson: Track one product and person across changes in lighting, shot size and location; compare the final product frame with its earlier appearance.
entries.lesson_zh: 观察同一人物和产品如何跨越光线、景别与地点变化；对照开头与结尾的产品外观。

entries.title: Suspense short: dialogue, reaction and sound reversal
entries.title_zh: 悬疑短片：对白、反应与声音反转
entries.author: drjoetw
entries.lesson: The sequence builds a question, follows a pointing gesture, then answers it through a reaction shot. Audio changes carry the tonal reversal.
entries.lesson_zh: 先制造疑问，再跟随指向动作揭示目标，用反应镜头收束；声音变化承担气氛反转。

entries.title: Swimming sequence: distinguish four motion patterns
entries.title_zh: 游泳片段：区分四种动作
entries.author: johnAGI168
entries.lesson: Use this as a motion-clarity study: inspect transitions and whether each action remains recognizable at the allotted speed.
entries.lesson_zh: 重点研究动作能否看清：检查泳姿切换，以及分配的时间是否足够辨认动作。

entries.title: Game interface: a readable turn-based sequence
entries.title_zh: 游戏界面：让回合过程清楚可读
entries.author: AllaAisling
entries.lesson: Follow state changes: cards appear, one is selected, an action resolves, resources update, then the opposing turn begins. Check whether overlays stay anchored during camera changes.
entries.lesson_zh: 沿状态变化阅读：发牌、选择、执行、资源更新、对方回合；检查镜头变化时界面是否固定。

entries.title: Street-food vlog: place, preparation and reaction
entries.title_zh: 街头美食：环境、制作与人物反应
entries.author: nawalsehar
entries.lesson: Compare wide location context, preparation detail and the tasting reaction; these serve different storytelling purposes.
entries.lesson_zh: 对比环境全景、制作细节和试吃反应，理解三者不同的叙事作用。

entries.title: Cliffside chase: one continuous camera path
entries.title_zh: 悬崖追逐：连续运镜的空间路线
entries.author: umesh_ai
entries.lesson: Study how obstacles motivate reframing while the moving subject supplies a continuous point of attention. The ending shifts from pursuit to a wide reveal.
entries.lesson_zh: 观察障碍如何推动重新构图，同时让运动主体持续吸引视线；结尾从追逐转为开阔空间展示。

entries.title: Motion poster: assemble a layout without losing it
entries.title_zh: 动态海报：逐步组装但不破坏版式
entries.author: LudovicCreator
entries.lesson: Treat the poster as layered components that enter in a deliberate order, then settle long enough to read. Preserve hierarchy rather than filling every region with movement.
entries.lesson_zh: 把海报拆成按顺序进入的图层，再留出阅读停顿；保持视觉层级，不让所有区域同时运动。

entries.title: Japanese animation teaser: identity and expression control
entries.title_zh: 日语动画预告：身份与表情控制
entries.author: haruuraeadss
entries.lesson: Separate the character lock from permitted expression and gesture changes. The prompt also assigns camera changes to moments of discovery.
entries.lesson_zh: 把人物外观固定项与允许变化的表情、动作分开；镜头变化对应发现线索的时刻。
